segments.english: Unit 11, Western festivals. Words and expressions.
1. Easter is on a Sunday in March or April.
At Easter, children usually eat chocolate eggs.
2. Halloween is on the 31st of October.
Children in the US and the UK love this festival.
They get candy from their neighbours.
3. Thanksgiving is on the 4th Thursday in November.
It is a holiday in the US.
People usually eat turkey on Thanksgiving Day.
4. Christmas is on the 25th of December.
It is an important festival in many Western countries.
People give presents to each other at Christmas.
Children wait for presents from Father Christmas on Christmas Eve.
1. Rudolph had a big red nose.
He did not like it because his friends laughed at him.
Father Christmas was on his way to give presents to children.
Rudolph and his friends helped Father Christmas.
Father Christmas could not find his way.
Oh no! Where am I? Help!
Father Christmas could see his way.
Rudolph, is that you? Your nose is so bright.
5. Rudolph took Father Christmas to the children.
He loved his big red nose.
You have a great nose, Rudolph!
